correctness.rationale: CDE first two channels equal X, third is F(X)=1/2∫X∧dX. Reflection of an arbitrary open path across the line joining its endpoints, then reversed traversal, creates a closed path of length ≤2B with signed area 2F; the signed isoperimetric inequality therefore gives |F|≤B²/(2π). Against any finite deterministic adaptive querying policy the adversary maintains a positive query-free time gap separating values 0 and q=(2B/π,0), answering left queries 0 and right queries q; reference straight transition fits B. After the finite transcript, two absolutely continuous opposite semicircle traversals of radius B/π fit entirely in the gap, use precisely total length B, return the same answers, and give F=±B²/(2π). Independently integrated the semicircle polynomial/trigonometric area exactly; no bound on instantaneous derivative invalidates short-gap hiding. Upper/lower match for each fixed finite N, with no appeal to asymptotics.

evidence: Full primary PDF Section 5 and Appendix D use bounded derivative to bound variation allocation over observed mesh; its 1/N factor relies on the uniform local speed budget.
